source.book: 据《史记》卷五十六《陈丞相世家》改编。
source.excerpt: 里中社，平爲宰，分肉食甚均。父老曰：「善，陳孺子之爲宰！」平曰：「嗟乎，使平得宰天下，亦如是肉矣！」

imageReview.originalPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished Histree Chinese lianhuanhua atlas for《陈平分肉》, EXACTLY 6 illustrations in STRICT 2 columns × 3 rows, equal cells, left to right then down. Target canvas 1024×990. Thin straight cream gutters about 6px, no outer margin, no header/footer, no inset, no merged cells. Each cell is a LANDSCAPE illustration. NO TEXT, captions, numbers, letters, calligraphy, speech balloons, watermark anywhere. Documents must be blank.
STYLE REFERENCE: attached image is only the established visual style, NOT story content/layout/text. Match exaggerated expressive ADULT folk-art characters, larger heads with angular noses/eyebrows and spare fine BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte indigo/ochre/cinnabar/green color blocks, restrained subtle paper grain, cream negative space and simple geometric backgrounds, early Shanghai animation / 1950s Chinese small-picture books. No realistic facial modeling, elaborate brocade, modern anime, 3D, glossy digital painting or dense brown noise. Preserve ancient Chinese clothing and props. No props/events copied from the reference.
CHARACTERS AND INVARIANTS: 陈平年轻成年青绿袍黑束发；父老白须土黄袍；祭肉已煮熟置木盘，无屠宰。六格依次准备、分配、领取、称赞、回应、交谈，不画登基。
Scenes, exactly in this order (Chinese captions here describe events to ILLUSTRATE; never render their text):
1. 乡里举行祭社活动，陈平被安排主管分肉。
2. 他把祭肉分给参加的人，处置得很均衡。
3. 肉一份份分出去，父老看见了他的做法。
4. 父老称赞：陈家这个年轻人，真会主持这件事！
5. 陈平感叹：如果让我有机会治理天下……
6. “也要像分这些肉一样！”一件乡里小事，显出了他的志向。
imageReview.notes: 原画六格，阅读选用第1、2、4、5格共四格；略去重复领取与重复回应，原画完整保留。均分、父老赞许、陈平志向可辨。
